long_biography.plain_text:
Diamond Parking combines parking management with property acquisition and partnership-based commercial development. Joel R. Diamond leads the Seattle company as chairman and chief executive, overseeing a business whose locations include municipal programmes, hospitals, airports, hotels and sports venues.

Diamond assumed the senior operating role after the company had pioneered self-service parking under his father, Josef. He has also served on the National Parking Association board, bringing the family enterprise into wider industry governance. Jon Diamond now works alongside him as president and chief operating officer, with responsibility for leasing, real estate and marketing.
